article.story: CLEVELAND -- — Dhani Miller scored 16 points as Kent State beat Cleveland State 69-62 on Saturday. Miller also added six rebounds and five steals for the Golden Flashes (2-3). Jamal Sumlin shot 4 of 6 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line to add 14 points. Latif Diouf shot 3 of 3 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line to finish with 10 points. Curtis Stinson Jr. led the way for the Vikings (3-4) with 10 points. Gavin Headings added 10 points for Cleveland State. Xavier McKinney also had nine points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
